description: Week number and week-year for dates under ISO 8601, US or custom rules (53-week years) — Returns the week number, week-year, number of weeks in that year and the week's first and last day for up to 200 dates under ISO 8601 (Monday start, week 1 holds 4 January), the US convention (Sunday start, week 1 holds 1 January) or a custom weekStart/minimalDays rule, and checks an asserted week or week-year (2027-01-01 is ISO 2026-W53). Built for an agent reading or writing week-based dates in

minimalDays.description: Days of the new year the first week must contain (custom).

system.description: iso: weekStart Monday, minimalDays 4. us: weekStart Sunday, minimalDays 1. custom: give weekStart and minimalDays.

name: week-number
